chainlink.description: The secure-by-default verifier for CCIP, run by a decentralized committee of 16 independent, professional node operators who validate every cross-chain message through onchain consensus.

cctp.description: A verifier built on Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol, giving USDC transfers native attestation.

lombard.description: A verifier from the Lombard Security Consortium that validates transfers of tokens issued by Lombard, enabling them to enforce their own internal security and compliance standards, in addition to the security provided by the Chainlink Committee Verifier.

dummy.description: A placeholder verifier used for testing and development purposes. It does not provide real cross-chain validation and should not be relied on in production environments.
